name: Hipólyto
bio: Gabriel Felipe Hipolito Domingues Silva (Nova Iguaçu, March 13, 1998), known professionally as Hipólyto, is a Brazilian actor, singer, and voice actor.
place: Nova Iguaçu, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

credits.title: Waves
credits.overview: The lives of two men are connected by a succession of events in the course of one night.

credits.title: Pecadora
credits.overview: Isabel is a very religious young woman whose life is transformed when she starts working with Enrico, a free-spirited and seductive man. As she tries to deny her attraction to her colleague and the awakening of her most forbidden desires, she finds herself confronting everything she always believed.

credits.title: Turvo
credits.overview: The film follows João, a 20-year-old boy who lives in the small town of Turvo, on the weekend before he receives his college application results. If he gets accepted, he will have to leave his city, his family, his friends and his comfort zone.
